$comment: Project-scoped Claude Code settings for the Sage repository. The committed twin of .codex/config.toml:
same two guardrails, same scripts, same portable path resolution, so the two harnesses behave the same
way instead of one silently enforcing nothing.
Scope rule matches the Codex file: only settings useful to *anyone* working on Sage belong here.
Personal permissions, MCP toggles, and machine-specific preferences stay in the gitignored
History: this file did not exist until 2026-08-11. .claude/settings.local.json had no hooks section at
all, so the architecture gate and the retention guard ran under Codex and nowhere else. The gate script
also read only tool_input.command, which is the Codex apply_patch shape -- pointing Claude Code at it
unchanged would have installed a guard that inspected zero paths and exited 0. Both halves are fixed;
both event dialects and both verdict lanes.
